verdicts.reproduction: All reproductions re-run independently (review/work/43/verify/). (a) steptest joint with my own literal implementation (my_43.3.py: fixed linspace(0,L,100) grid via sol.sol, guess [Ppl,Ppr,30,Ppr]): 43.3 FAIL; isolate shows tests 1-3 FAIL, boolean test 4 PASS. (b) h5 nz targets span 0.0062-0.073, so cmp_tuple_or_list's default np.allclose demands per-element agreement of 7.2e-8..7.4e-7; a tightly converged reference (solve_bvp tol=1e-9, max_nodes=1e5) deviates from the frozen nz by maxabs 1.194e-6 / 6.845e-7 / 2.152e-6 with 25/48/42 of 100 elements violating the bound for tests 1/2/3 -> np.allclose False for ALL three, while Pout passes everywhere (rel err <= 3.7e-7). The frozen targets therefore embed the author's unconverged (default tol=1e-3) run noise, and even a PERFECT solution fails. (c) Re-ran the old-environment check myself (review/work/43/oldenv, scipy 1.11.4/numpy 1.26.4): 28 mesh-x-guess configs, every converged one still misses head or tail by ~1e-6 (best: head 2.78e-8 but tail 1.15e-6) -> not numpy-2.x drift; gold-era scipy fails too. (d) Author-plausible sweep on current env (mesh 10-1000 x tol 1e-3..1e-8 x 18 guesses x 2 eval conventions, sweep.py): zero passing configurations. Confirmed blocker: no correct implementation can pass tests 1-3.

verdicts.reproduction: Re-ran branch-sensitivity probes myself. Current env (scipy 1.15.2), Ppl=50/Ppr=30, 100-pt mesh, default tol: signal guess 0.01 W -> sol.status=0 (solver reports SUCCESS) on the trivial non-lasing branch, Pout=-2.0e-8 instead of ~67.6 W; guess 1 W -> status=1 (no convergence). Old env (scipy 1.11.4), Ppl=Ppr=50: guess (1,1) -> status=0, Pout=2e-8; guesses (10,10)/(20,20) -> status=1; guesses >=30 W converge to the lasing branch (Pout=85.09). The prompt/docstring say nothing about the initial guess. One correction to the first pass's reasoning: its mitigating argument ('solver may copy the y_guess pattern from 43.1's test code') is invalid -- gencode.py builds prompts from step descriptions, backgrounds, headers and previous code only; test cases are never shown to the model. Severity nevertheless stays major (not blocker) because the physically natural pump-scale seed (tens of watts, matching Ppl/Ppr magnitudes) does reach the lasing branch, and the step is already blocked by the D6 finding.

summary: All three first-pass findings on 43.3 are confirmed with independently re-run evidence: the frozen nz targets embed the author's unconverged solve_bvp(tol=1e-3) noise (~1e-6) which exceeds the default np.allclose bound (7.2e-8 at the smallest nz), so even a perfectly converged correct solution fails all three numeric tests (D6 blocker); the 100-point output grid and the lasing-branch initial guess are unstated and underivable from anything the model is shown (two D4 majors). One first-pass argument corrected: models never see test code, so the '43.1 test hint' mitigation was invalid (severity unchanged). One missed minor D8 added: boolean test 4 passes even for the non-lasing branch. The problem is fixable to fair with moderate effort: regenerate the three 43.3 (Pout, nz) targets from a converged solve (recipe provided, review/work/43/verify/regen_recipe.py) and add one sentence to the step prompt pinning grid, tolerance, and initial guess; steps 43.1 and 43.2 are clean and pass as-is.
